candidates.quote: Operating margin was 17.2%, an increase from 15.3%
Restaurant level operating margin was 27.5% 1, an increase of 230 basis points
Diluted earnings per share was $12.32, a 33.2% increase from $9.25
Net income for the second quarter was $341.8 million, or $12.32 per diluted share
Food, beverage and packaging costs in the second quarter were 29.4% of total revenue
General and administrative expenses for the second quarter were $156.5 million on a GAAP basis
The effective income tax rate for the second quarter was 23.8% compared to 25.3%
Third quarter comparable restaurant sales growth in the low to mid-single digit range
Opened 47 new restaurants with 40 locations including a Chipotlane
We repurchased $87.6 million of stock at an average price per share of $1,937.35
